nodes.label: ad_spend
nodes.description: What advertisers pay for clicks on sponsored products (platform ad revenue).

nodes.label: ad_load
nodes.description: Sponsored impressions per session - set by the pacing controller, not by traffic.

nodes.label: stockout_rate
nodes.description: Out-of-stock listings met per product view (for display; moves with traffic, so it is not used as a cause).

nodes.label: conversion_rate
nodes.decomposition: views_per_session * add_to_cart_rate * checkout_rate * payment_attempt_rate * payment_success_rate * order_rate

nodes.label: payment_attempt_rate
nodes.description: Payment attempts per checkout (above 1 means retries).

nodes.label: order_rate
nodes.description: Orders per successful payment (should stay near 1).

nodes.label: contribution
nodes.description: Marketplace contribution per hour - fees and ad revenue minus platform-funded discounts.

nodes.label: marketplace_fees
nodes.description: Commission the marketplace earns on sales.

nodes.label: take_rate
nodes.description: Commission as a share of GMV.

nodes.label: discount_rate
nodes.description: Platform-funded discounts as a share of GMV.

nodes.label: gmv
nodes.description: Gross merchandise value of completed orders.

nodes.label: search_ctr
nodes.description: Clicks per search - a proxy for result relevance.

nodes.label: feed_impressions
nodes.description: Products shown in the personalised "For You" feed.

edges.note: unavailable products cannot be added to the cart
a feed full of unavailable products changes what people click

relevant search results lead customers to product pages
